learning_outcomes.text: Navigate Canva and set up brand-controlled workspaces
Build and apply a Brand Kit
Use elements, photos and effects effectively
Collaborate and manage approvals in teams
Export and publish content across channels

integrative_case: A brand manager must set up Canva for a marketing team to produce on-brand content at scale. They must configure a Brand Kit, build reusable templates, manage elements and contrast, set team roles and approvals, and export correctly per channel, defending brand controls against inconsistent one-off designs.
